title: Cycle Calendar Card: Supply, Cycle Date Basis and Lead Time by Auto Refill & Medication Sync Program
content:
Days supply per cycle, what sets the next cycle date, and how many calendar days ahead of that date the refill is processed differ across the Auto Refill & Medication Sync programs, as does the point at which Kestrel offers the 90-day program.

| Program | Days supply dispensed by each automated cycle | What sets the next cycle date | Refill processed this many calendar days before the cycle date | Filled cycles after which Kestrel offers conversion to the 90-day program |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | 30 days | last fill date | 4 | 3 |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | 90 days | last fill date | 7 | 0 (not offered) |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | 30 days | sync day | 7 | 3 |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | 90 days | sync day | 10 | 0 (not offered) |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | 28 days | sync day | 10 | 0 (not offered) |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | 90 days | last fill date | 10 | 0 (not offered) |

## Notes to the card

- **Days supply** is a whole number of days dispensed by each automated cycle.
- **Cycle date basis** takes one of two values: the last fill date, or the sync day. The three Auto Refill programs (Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day, Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day, Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill) run on the last fill date; the three Med Sync programs run on the sync day.
- **Lead time** is counted in calendar days before the cycle date.
- **Conversion offer** is a whole number of filled cycles; a figure of 0 means the offer is not made in that program. Only Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day and Kestrel Med Sync Monthly list a figure above 0, namely 3 filled cycles.

## The card read across

The lead time grows with the program: 4 calendar days for Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day; 7 for Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day and Kestrel Med Sync Monthly; 10 for Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day, Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging and Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill. Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging is the only program whose cycle supplies 28 days rather than 30 or 90.
